title: NIST WebBook: Tin is Sn, molecular weight 118.710 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Tin as Sn, molecular weight 118.710 amu, CAS 7440-31-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Tin, CAS Registry Number 7440-31-5, lists molecular formula Sn and molecular weight 118.710 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 119.9021947 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Sn. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
